question: When the caterpillar is ready to enter the next stage of its life cycle called ______, it first weaves a net to hold itself.
solution:
The correct answer is __**pupa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **When the caterpillar is ready to enter the next stage of its life cycle called pupa, it first weaves a net to hold itself.**
 
• The life cycle of a silkworm is Egg­ > Caterpillar ­> Pupa­ > Adult.</li
